meta.name: Setout
meta.essence: The drawing becomes a line on the ground.
meta.promise: Setout turns a construction drawing into measured points, grids and levels on a live site, so the building starts from a datum everyone can check rather than from a render nobody can.
meta.hero: E · full-screen photo · relation on · recipe R8
meta.styleReason: Q1 was an explicit named pick of #4 Blueprint grid. The photographs agree: one holds a printed plan, one is a lattice of steel scaffolding, and one carries a blue hard hat. Glass, paper and mesh would contradict the site.
